project.name: SmartERP
project.description: HR-domain ERP learning project: ASP.NET Core MVC over a hand-built Oracle schema

tasks.title: Fix EmployeeController and EmployeeRepository
tasks.notes: Repository bugs fixed (GetByIdAsync join/aliases/null end_date, UpdateAsync detail statement, DeleteAsync nonexistent column, CreateWithDetailsAsync RETURNING id) and EmployeeController completed (create with conditional details routing, update, delete). Awaiting user verification against live Oracle. double->decimal refactor intentionally deferred.

tasks.title: Build employment_details feature: lookup repos, repository, controller, views
tasks.notes: New EmploymentDetailsRepository: create guarding uq_det_current_job via typed exception, close/update with end_date, list by employee. LookupRepository for genders, employment_types, employment_status dropdowns. Views under Views/Employment.

tasks.title: Build department_managers feature
tasks.notes: Repository and UI for assigning a manager to a department with start_date, closing with end_date. uq_dept_current_manager must surface as a typed duplicate-current-assignment exception.

tasks.title: Sync docs and db scripts with actual codebase
tasks.notes: README claims 04_triggers.sql but disk has 03_triggers.sql and 04_test.sql. Verify trigger contents, fix README, clarify Oracle connection string storage (missing from appsettings.json; document user-secrets if used).

tasks.title: Refactor ids from double to decimal across models, repos and controllers
tasks.notes: Oracle NUMBER maps cleanly to decimal; double risks rounding drift. Touches Employee/Department/EmployeeWithDetails models, repositories, view models, controller parameters in one sweep.

tasks.title: Complete department delete flow (missing Delete.cshtml and GET action)
tasks.notes: DepartmentController POST Delete returns View(model) on invalid ModelState but Views/Department/Delete.cshtml does not exist and no GET Delete action is defined. Add confirmation view mirroring Employee Delete.
